summary_1line: Rama calms Lakshmana, insisting Bharata comes in love, rejecting the idea of fighting his brother for the kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama gently restrains the furious Lakshmana in the forest while speaking calmly about Bharata’s loyalty.
Rama touches his arms solemnly, vowing he would never accept a kingdom gained by killing his brother.
